X.description: Settings of the X (Twitter) integration feature, used by the X API client. These values override the ones configured in the admin settings, and they are only applied when the 'ConfigureTwitterSettings()' extension method is called on the OrchardCoreBuilder. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/X/.

ConsumerKey.description: The API key (consumer key) of the X app, found in the keys and tokens tab of the app.

ConsumerSecret.description: The API secret key (consumer secret) of the X app. This is a sensitive value: provide it through user secrets, environment variables or a key vault rather than appsettings.json.

AccessToken.description: The access token of the X app, found in the keys and tokens tab of the app.

AccessTokenSecret.description: The access token secret of the X app. This is a sensitive value: provide it through user secrets, environment variables or a key vault rather than appsettings.json.

OrchardCore_X.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_X' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:X' instead.

OrchardCore_Twitter.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_Twitter' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:X' instead.
